# T-201, R-U2: readonly interface methods `const Name() string` in .lgo contracts.
# The contract package declares `const Name() string` inside interface braces
# only, parallel to the existing `const Name T` property prefix. A pure value-
# receiver getter satisfies it structurally across packages: the user package
# names the qualified interface (`c.Namer`), converts through it, and calls
# through a const view of the imported concrete type after export/import.
# A mutating plain `*Bad` receiver from another package is rejected at the
# call site through a const view with the approved call-site diagnostic; no
# new satisfaction/obligation string is pinned here (parent ticket owns it).
# A Go importer in another workspace module sees the erased `Name() string`
# (plain-interface assignment both ways runs); the Logos view keeps the
# readonly proof. A stale `__.LOGOS` fingerprint, and an incremental rebuild
# after the imported getter proof changes, cannot reuse the old proof.
# Modules stay homogeneous: w/l and neg are all-.lgo, w/g is all-.go; the
# stale/impcheck helpers are stdlib-only Go mains under w/g. Behavior is
# proven by installed `logos build`/`logos run` output, never source grep.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# Case 1: pure getter accepted through the qualified interface and const
# view after export/import; the Go importer runs against erased signatures.
cd w
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgoiface$GOEXE ./l/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/lgoiface$GOEXE
stdout '^lgo-ok$'
logos build -o $WORK/bin/goiface$GOEXE ./g/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/goiface$GOEXE
stdout '^go-ok$'
cd ..

# Case 2: a mutating plain-pointer receiver from another package is rejected
# at the const-view call site with the approved call-site diagnostic.
cd neg
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\] cannot call Name through const view'
cd ..

# Case 3: the contract archive carries the bound facts sidecar; flipping its
# fingerprint fails the dependent import instead of reusing the old readonly
# proof, while a Go importer reading only __.PKGDEF still sees Name() string.
go tool compile -p example.com/l/c -o $WORK/lc.a w/l/c/c.lgo
go tool pack t $WORK/lc.a
stdout '__\.LOGOS'
cd w/g
go run ./stale $WORK/lc.a $WORK/lc-stale.a
mkdir $WORK/impstale
mkdir $WORK/impstale/example.com
mkdir $WORK/impstale/example.com/l
cp $WORK/lc-stale.a $WORK/impstale/example.com/l/c.a
! go tool compile -I $WORK/impstale -p example.com/l/p -o $WORK/p-stale.a ../l/p/p.lgo
stdout 'logos: stale facts for example\.com/l/c \(fingerprint mismatch\)'
go run ./impcheck $WORK/lc.a
stdout '^importer ok: Namer-Name 0 1$'
cd ../..

# Case 4: incremental rebuild after the imported getter proof changes cannot
# reuse the old qualification. The const-view call builds cleanly against the
# pure getter, then the implementation package is rewritten so Good.Name
# mutates receiver-reachable state; rebuilding rejects the same call site
# instead of reusing the cached readonly proof.
cd re
logos build ./...
logos run ./cmd
stdout '^re-ok$'
cp badsrc/p.lgo.bad p/p.lgo
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\] cannot call Name through const view'
cd ..

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w/l/c/c.lgo --
package c

type Namer interface {
	const Name() string
}

func Greet(n Namer) string {
	return n.Name()
}

-- w/l/p/p.lgo --
package p

import "example.com/l/c"

type Good struct {
	name string
}

func (g Good) Name() string {
	return g.name
}

func Make(name string) Good {
	return Good{name: name}
}

func MakeNamer(name string) c.Namer {
	return Make(name)
}

-- w/l/q/q.lgo --
package q

import (
	"example.com/l/c"
	"example.com/l/p"
)

var _ c.Namer = p.Make("x")

func ViaQualified(n c.Namer) string {
	return n.Name()
}

func ViaConstView(g const p.Good) string {
	return g.Name()
}

func Run() string {
	g := p.Make("ada")
	if ViaQualified(g) != "ada" {
		return "bad-qualified"
	}
	if ViaConstView(g) != "ada" {
		return "bad-constview"
	}
	if c.Greet(g) != "ada" {
		return "bad-greet"
	}
	if p.MakeNamer("ada").Name() != "ada" {
		return "bad-makenamer"
	}
	return "lgo-ok"
}

-- w/l/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/l/q"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(q.Run())
}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- w/g/qq/qq.go --
package qq

import (
	"example.com/l/c"
	"example.com/l/p"
)

type G string

func (g G) Name() string { return string(g) }

func Run() string {
	var plain interface{ Name() string } = p.Make("ada")
	if plain.Name() != "ada" {
		return "bad-erased"
	}
	var n c.Namer = p.Make("ada")
	if n.Name() != "ada" {
		return "bad-name"
	}
	if c.Greet(n) != "ada" {
		return "bad-greet"
	}
	var m c.Namer = G("bob")
	if m.Name() != "bob" {
		return "bad-go-impl"
	}
	if c.Greet(m) != "bob" {
		return "bad-go-greet"
	}
	return "go-ok"
}

-- w/g/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/g/qq"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(qq.Run()) }

-- w/g/stale/main.go --
// Command stale copies a compiler archive while flipping one hex digit of
// the __.LOGOS fingerprint line, producing an archive whose facts are stale
// relative to its __.PKGDEF.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

func fatal(err any) {
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "stale: %v\n", err)
	os.Exit(1)
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 3 {
		fatal("usage: stale in.a out.a")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	if !bytes.HasPrefix(raw, []byte("!<arch>\n")) {
		fatal("not an archive")
	}
	off := len("!<arch>\n")
	found := false
	for off+60 <= len(raw) {
		hdr := raw[off : off+60]
		if hdr[58] != '`' || hdr[59] != '\n' {
			fatal("corrupt header")
		}
		name := strings.TrimRight(string(hdr[:16]), " ")
		size, err := strconv.ParseUint(strings.TrimRight(string(hdr[48:58]), " "), 10, 64)
		if err != nil {
			fatal(err)
		}
		dataOff := off + 60
		if name == "__.LOGOS" {
			end := dataOff + int(size)
			if end > len(raw) {
				fatal("truncated member")
			}
			i := bytes.Index(raw[dataOff:end], []byte("fingerprint "))
			if i < 0 {
				fatal("no fingerprint line")
			}
			hexOff := dataOff + i + len("fingerprint ")
			if hexOff >= end {
				fatal("empty fingerprint")
			}
			if raw[hexOff] == '0' {
				raw[hexOff] = '1'
			} else {
				raw[hexOff] = '0'
			}
			found = true
			break
		}
		off = dataOff + int(size) + int(size&1)
	}
	if !found {
		fatal("no __.LOGOS member")
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Args[2], raw, 0o666); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
}

-- w/g/impcheck/main.go --
// Command impcheck proves a Go importer reads only __.PKGDEF from a loGo/s
// contract archive: Namer is visible with the erased method Name() string,
// unaffected by the __.LOGOS sidecar. It asserts no readonly fact line,
// only the erased Go signature.
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"go/importer"
	"go/token"
	"go/types"
	"io"
	"os"
)

func fatal(err any) {
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "impcheck: %v\n", err)
	os.Exit(1)
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		fatal("usage: impcheck archive.a")
	}
	path := os.Args[1]
	imp := importer.ForCompiler(token.NewFileSet(), "gc", func(p string) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
		if p != "example.com/l/c" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown package %s", p)
		}
		return os.Open(path)
	})
	pkg, err := imp.Import("example.com/l/c")
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	obj := pkg.Scope().Lookup("Namer")
	tn, ok := obj.(*types.TypeName)
	if !ok {
		fatal("Namer not a type name")
	}
	iface, ok := tn.Type().Underlying().(*types.Interface)
	if !ok {
		fatal("Namer not an interface")
	}
	var found *types.Func
	for i := 0; i < iface.NumMethods(); i++ {
		if iface.Method(i).Name() == "Name" {
			found = iface.Method(i)
		}
	}
	if found == nil {
		fatal("Namer has no Name method")
	}
	sig, ok := found.Type().(*types.Signature)
	if !ok {
		fatal("Name not a signature")
	}
	if sig.Params().Len() != 0 || sig.Results().Len() != 1 {
		fatal("Name has wrong arity")
	}
	if sig.Results().At(0).Type().String() != "string" {
		fatal("Name result not string")
	}
	fmt.Println("importer ok: Namer-Name 0 1")
}

-- neg/go.mod --
module example.com/neg

go 1.27

-- neg/c/c.lgo --
package c

type Namer interface {
	const Name() string
}

func Greet(n Namer) string {
	return n.Name()
}

-- neg/b/b.lgo --
package b

type Bad struct {
	N int
}

func (m *Bad) Name() string {
	m.N++
	return "bad"
}

-- neg/u/u.lgo --
package u

import (
	"example.com/neg/b"
	"example.com/neg/c"
)

func ViaQualified(n c.Namer) string {
	return n.Name()
}

func Touch(q const *b.Bad) string {
	return q.Name()
}

-- re/go.mod --
module example.com/re

go 1.27

-- re/c/c.lgo --
package c

type Namer interface {
	const Name() string
}

func Greet(n Namer) string {
	return n.Name()
}

-- re/p/p.lgo --
package p

import "example.com/re/c"

type Good struct {
	name string
}

func (g Good) Name() string {
	return g.name
}

func Make(name string) Good {
	return Good{name: name}
}

func MakeNamer(name string) c.Namer {
	return Make(name)
}

-- re/badsrc/p.lgo.bad --
package p

// No MakeNamer here by design: the rewritten package must fail only at q's
// const-view call site with the approved call-site diagnostic, never at a
// conformance conversion whose string is parent-owned and unpinned.
type Good struct {
	name string
	hits []int
}

func (g Good) Name() string {
	g.hits[0] = 1
	return g.name
}

func Make(name string) Good {
	return Good{name: name}
}

-- re/q/q.lgo --
package q

import "example.com/re/p"

func ViaConstView(g const p.Good) string {
	return g.Name()
}

func Run() string {
	g := p.Make("re")
	if ViaConstView(g) != "re" {
		return "bad-constview"
	}
	return "re-ok"
}

-- re/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/re/q"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(q.Run())
}
